blocks.orig: If you crave an adventure after your wedding, our Tanzania honeymoon packages take you to Africa’s top safari destinations. Dive into the depths of the Ngorongoro Crater, witness the Great Migration in the world-famous Serengeti and discover gems like Lake Manyara or Arusha National Park. In these beautiful landscapes, you’ll come eye to eye with African animals of all kinds, including the Big Five.
blocks.html: Looking for adventure once the wedding is over? Our Tanzania honeymoon packages bring you to the finest safari destinations in Africa. Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, follow the Great Migration across the legendary Serengeti and explore lesser-known gems such as Lake Manyara or Arusha National Park. Amid these beautiful landscapes you will find yourself face to face with African wildlife of every kind, the Big Five included.

blocks.orig: You want to add that special something to your safari? Then head out after sunset during a night game drive. Your heart will beat a little faster when you spot some shy nocturnal animals or simply a pair of eyes in the dark of the night… the perfect excuse to move a little closer to your loved one.
blocks.html: Want to give your safari an extra touch? Then set out after dark on a night game drive. Your pulse will quicken as you catch a glimpse of shy nocturnal animals, or simply a pair of eyes shining in the darkness… the ideal excuse to snuggle up a little closer to your partner.

blocks.orig: Tanzania is also home to Africa’s highest peak, Mount Kilimanjaro. Of course, you can climb it with your partner – an experience which will strengthen your bond even further.
blocks.html: Africa’s highest peak, Mount Kilimanjaro, is in Tanzania too. You can of course climb it together with your partner, an experience that will only deepen the bond between you.

blocks.orig: Discover Tanzania during your safari with your personal safari guide and vehicle at your own pace. You want to see all the highlights in one national park, or travel around to see as much as possible from this unique country? Everything is possible: our private honeymoon safaris are tailored to your wishes.
blocks.html: Explore Tanzania on safari at your own pace, with your own guide and your own vehicle. Would you rather see every highlight of a single national park, or travel around and take in as much of this unique country as you can? Anything goes: our private honeymoon safaris are shaped around your wishes.

blocks.orig: Spend lazy afternoons observing prides of lions, start early to witness elephants bathe at sunrise, or picnic under acacia trees in absolute privacy before heading out to search for that animal you’ve always wanted to see. The itinerary of your Tanzania and Zanzibar honeymoon is 100% up to you.
blocks.html: Pass a lazy afternoon watching a pride of lions, get up early to see elephants bathing at sunrise, or enjoy a completely private picnic beneath the acacias before setting off in search of the one animal you have always longed to see. The programme of your Tanzania and Zanzibar honeymoon is entirely yours to decide.

blocks.orig: Safari and beach – a match made in heaven
blocks.html: Safari plus beach: the perfect combination

blocks.orig: When spending your honeymoon in Tanzania, Zanzibar or another paradise-like island should be on your list! After a safari filled with wildlife and wonder, it’s time to discover another side of Tanzania.
blocks.html: If you are honeymooning in Tanzania, Zanzibar or one of the other paradise islands belongs on your itinerary! Once your safari full of wildlife and wonder is done, it is time to get to know a very different side of Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Slip away to Zanzibar or islands like Pemba, Mnemba or Mafia, which are almost made for honeymooning. Lounge hand-in-hand underneath the palm trees, wander along the pearly white sand and jump into the turquoise Indian Ocean.
blocks.html: Escape to Zanzibar or to islands such as Pemba, Mnemba or Mafia, which seem to have been created for honeymooners. Relax together beneath the palms, stroll along pearly white beaches and dive into the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean.

blocks.orig: Of course, you can also fill your days with cultural and thrilling activities: from wandering through the alleyways and spice markets in Stone Town to swimming with whale sharks – boredom is something you won’t encounter here.
blocks.html: You can just as easily fill your days with culture and excitement: wander the alleys and spice markets of Stone Town or go swimming with whale sharks. One thing you will not find here is boredom.

blocks.orig: No matter how you spend your day, end it with a candlelit dinner for two for that very special sparkle.
blocks.html: However you choose to spend the day, round it off with a candlelit dinner for two to add that extra special sparkle.

blocks.orig: Adventure, culture, relaxation – there are plenty of unforgettable activities for your honeymoon in Tanzania and Zanzibar. These are our top three:
blocks.html: Adventure, culture or pure relaxation: a honeymoon in Tanzania and Zanzibar offers no shortage of unforgettable things to do. Here are our three favourites:

blocks.orig: Sunset dhow cruise: Set sail aboard a graceful dhow ship built in the ancient Swahili style as the sun sinks slowly behind Zanzibar’s horizon. Enjoy tropical cocktails and delicious bites while grooving to live music and snuggling close to your sweetheart.
blocks.html: Sunset dhow cruise: Board an elegant dhow, built in the age-old Swahili style, and sail out as the sun slips slowly below Zanzibar’s horizon. Sip tropical cocktails, nibble on delicious snacks, sway to live music and cuddle up to your sweetheart.

blocks.orig: Hot air balloon safari: This special safari offers perspectives of Tanzania’s wilderness that few will ever witness. You and your loved one will lift off gently to Cloud Nine (almost) with a colourful balloon and in a woven basket. Simply slow down, fully soak in the majesty surrounding you, and enjoy.
blocks.html: Hot air balloon safari: This unusual safari shows you Tanzania’s wilderness from an angle very few people ever get to see. In a colourful balloon with a woven basket, you and your loved one rise gently towards Cloud Nine (or near enough). Just slow down, take in the majesty all around you, and savour the moment.

blocks.orig: Visit a Maasai village: Get to know this fascinating tribe and learn more about their everyday life and traditions. Nice plus: you can get some Maasai jewellery as the perfect honeymoon keepsakes. And if you want, you can even get married again in a traditional ceremony.
blocks.html: Visit a Maasai village: Meet this fascinating tribe and find out more about their daily life and traditions. A lovely bonus: Maasai jewellery makes the ideal honeymoon souvenir. And should you wish, you can even tie the knot a second time in a traditional ceremony.

blocks.orig: You want to see all of our activities? Then have a look on our activity page and choose your favourites either by region or simply get inspired.
blocks.html: Curious about the full range of activities? Browse our activity page, where you can pick your favourites by region or simply look around for inspiration.

blocks.orig: There is one activity, which is extra special – just like your new spouse 😉 While honeymooning in Tanzania, you can get married or renew your vows during a Maasai wedding. In a traditional village, the two of you get blessed by an elder and married the Maasai way: from clothes to food, from ceremony to celebration. Not only will you enjoy another most special day in your life, you will also become part of the tribe. A truly unique experience which will stay with you forever.
blocks.html: One activity stands out as extra special – much like your new spouse 😉 During your honeymoon in Tanzania you can marry or renew your vows in a Maasai wedding. In a traditional village an elder blesses the two of you and you are wed the Maasai way: clothing, food, ceremony and celebration included. You not only get to enjoy another of the most special days of your life, you also become part of the tribe. A one-of-a-kind experience that stays with you forever.

blocks.orig: After adventurous days spent safari-ing through Tanzania’s most beautiful parks and reserves, retreat into an oasis made for romance. We have carefully selected (and tested) all of our accommodations to make sure that you have everything you want and more.
blocks.html: After days of adventure on safari through Tanzania’s loveliest parks and reserves, withdraw to a haven built for romance. Every one of our accommodations has been carefully chosen (and tried out) by us, so that you have all you could wish for and then some.

blocks.orig: You can choose from comfortable and budget-friendly lodges (our Silver category), more luxurious hotels with cosy rooms, swimming pools and delicious food (our Gold category) and the most high-end accommodations pampering you with private villas, exquisite dining and romance galore (our Platinum category). If you want to stay at the crème de la crème, our Diamond Luxury resorts are perfect for you. These hotels are the country’s highest standard and make you feel like in Seventh Heaven.
blocks.html: The choice ranges from comfortable, budget-friendly lodges (our Silver category) to more luxurious hotels with snug rooms, swimming pools and fine food (our Gold category), right up to the most exclusive accommodations that spoil you with private villas, exquisite dining and romance in abundance (our Platinum category). Those who want nothing but the very best will love our Diamond Luxury resorts: these hotels set the highest standard in the country and leave you feeling as if you are in Seventh Heaven.

blocks.orig: But no matter if you spend the night in your cosy tent at the waterhole or in your deluxe villa at the sea – you will never forget these Tanzanian nights.
blocks.html: Whether you spend the night in a snug tent beside a waterhole or in a deluxe villa on the shore, these Tanzanian nights are ones you will never forget.
